title: Case 025: Why a Card Attempt Was Declined
initial_request: Mara wants to know why her £18.40 card payment at North Quay Books was declined.
overview: After completing identification checks on a verified call, an H&V agent searched the card authorisation journal for the specific attempt Mara identified. The journal showed that the attempt was declined because the available balance was insufficient to cover it. H&V displayed that explanation in the secure portal; no new payment was made.

next_action.summary: Search H&V’s card authorisation journal for the North Quay Books attempt for £18.40 identified by Mara, and check its recorded decline reason.

outcome: The secure portal showed that this specific attempt was declined because the available balance was insufficient to cover the £18.40 authorisation at the time. No new payment was made, and a future attempt is not guaranteed to succeed.

Case HV-025: The North Quay Books card attempt for £18.40 was declined because your available balance was insufficient to cover the authorisation at the time. No new payment has been made, and we can’t guarantee that a future attempt will be successful.
